differences.masterLldValue: SEC 003 prohibits accepting role, assignee or recipient as authority from the browser; actor must be resolved server-side

missingFacts.item: Status ID 577 (Cancelled) and 135 (Completed) mapping to approved workflow state names in the DRT state-transition document
Exact permission code required for DPP Ops group cancellation action (story names group membership only, not a discrete permission code)
Whether an outbox event (e.g. WorkflowTaskCreated or AskCancelled) must be written on cancellation, and if so the event type, version and recipient rule
Full list of cancellable ASK statuses beyond the two blocked states (577 Cancelled, 135 Completed); story states 'ASK is in a cancellable status' without enumerating all valid source states
Idempotency key requirement and scope for the cancel command (retry-sensitive state-changing operation per REL 001)
Comment entity table name and schema (story references 'Comment record with isDraft=false and isActive=true' but no approved entity name is listed in MLLD 9.2 for ASK comments)
Audit entity table name and schema (story references 'Audit record with action Core Ask Cancelled' but no approved audit entity name is listed in MLLD 9.2)
BU scope rule: whether cancellation is restricted to ASKs within the caller's BU or is global for any DPP Ops Editor

assumptions: Task status update on cancellation is excluded per AS1; WF 003 conflict is recorded as a difference and requires resolution before implementation.
cancelledBy in the request body is recorded as a difference against SEC 003; the card assumes server-side actor resolution is the correct behaviour pending confirmation.
Status constants 577 and 135 are taken as stated in the story; their mapping to approved workflow state names is a missing fact.

story:
# [ADO STORY DETAILS]
- **Story ID:** 1858
- **Title:** Core ASK API – Cancel Core ASK (US-ASK-015)

## Description
User Story
ID: US-ASK-015
As a permitted DPP Operations user,
I want to cancel a Core ASK by submitting a required comment,
So that the ASK can be marked as cancelled and an audit trail can be recorded.
Business Objective
Enable authorized users to cancel Core ASK records in valid statuses while preserving comment and audit traceability.
Feature Description
This story covers the API endpoint to cancel a Core ASK. On successful cancellation, the endpoint updates the ASK status to Cancelled, stores the comment, and writes an audit entry.
Scope – Included
Cancel a Core ASK by askId
Require cancellation comment
Update ASK status to Cancelled
Persist comment
Persist audit entry in response
Scope – Excluded
Cancel Rotational ASK
Task status updates not confirmed by current export
UI dialog content and presentation
RBAC rule definition
Preconditions
The Core ASK exists
Caller belongs to DPP Ops group / DPP Operation Editors
ASK is in a cancellable status
A comment is provided
Postconditions
ASK status is updated to 577 Cancelled
A new active non-draft comment is created
A new audit entry with action "Core Ask Cancelled" is created
Business Rules
comment is mandatory
Cancellation is not allowed if ASK is already Cancelled (577) or Completed (135)
Caller must be in DPP Ops group
Cancellation writes: ASK status update, Comment record with isDraft=false and isActive=true, Audit record with action "Core Ask Cancelled"
Status constant for Cancelled is 577
Completed status constant is 135
Functional Requirements
Expose POST /core-asks/{askId}/cancel
Accept required askId
Accept request body with required comment
Return confirmation payload including: askId, statusId, cancelledAt, cancelledBy, auditEntry.action, auditEntry.description, auditEntry.createdBy, auditEntry.createdOn
Validation Rules
askId must be valid
comment must be present
ASK must exist
ASK must not already be Cancelled or Completed
Caller must have DPP Ops permission
Error Handling / Exception Scenarios
Return 404 if askId is not found
Return 400 if comment is missing
Return 409 if ASK is already Cancelled or Completed
Return 403 if caller is not in DPP Ops group
API Details
Endpoint: /core-asks/{askId}/cancel
Method: POST
Request:
{
  "comment": "string",
  "askId": 124,
  "cancelledBy": "string"
}
Response:
{
  "askId": 12345,
  "statusId": 577,
  "cancelledAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "cancelledBy": "string",
  "auditEntry": {
    "action": "Core Ask Cancelled",
    "description": "string",
    "createdBy": "string",
    "createdOn": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
Dependencies
Core ASK status management
Comment creation service
Audit history creation service
Authorization service for DPP Ops group membership
Assumptions
Update of associated task status is unconfirmed and therefore excluded
Comment content validation beyond presence is not specified in the contract
Story Points
5
Definition of Done
Endpoint enforces permission and status rules
Comment is required and validated
ASK status updates to Cancelled
Audit and comment records are created
Positive and negative test cases are completed
Acceptance Criteria
Scenario: Cancel Core ASK successfully
Given a Core ASK exists in a cancellable status and the caller is in DPP Ops group
When the client calls POST /core-asks/{askId}/cancel with a valid comment
Then the API returns 200, sets the ASK status to 577, saves the comment, and creates an audit entry
Scenario: Missing cancellation comment
Given a valid cancellable Core ASK
When the client calls the cancel endpoint without comment
Then the API returns 400
Scenario: ASK already completed
Given the Core ASK status is 135 Completed
When the client calls the cancel endpoint
Then the API returns 409
Scenario: ASK already cancelled
Given the Core ASK status is 577 Cancelled
When the client calls the cancel endpoint
Then the API returns 409
Scenario: User lacks permission
Given the caller is not in the DPP Ops group
When the client calls the cancel endpoint
Then the API returns 403
Scenario: ASK not found
Given the provided askId does not exist
When the client calls the cancel endpoint
Then the API returns 404
